description_en: Specifies the organizational unit (OU) and administrator for an AD office network (formerly workspace)
description_zh: 为AD办公网络（原工作区）指定组织单元OU和管理员
kebab_example: aliyun ecd config-ad-connector-user --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-7784180000 --domain-user-name Administrator --domain-password testPassword --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigADConnectorUser

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AD office network
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The organizational unit (OU) of the AD domain. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311259.html to obtain the value
parameters.help_zh: AD域的组织单元OU。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311259.html获取
parameters.name: ou_name

parameters.help_en: The username of the AD user that has the permission to join computers to the domain. The AD user specified here must have the permission to join computers to the domain. After the configuration is complete, cloud computers created in the corresponding AD office network are added to the specified OU
parameters.help_zh:
具有加域权限的AD用户的用户名。    
此处配置的AD用户需具备将计算机加入域的权限。配置成功后，在对应AD办公网络下创建的云电脑将加入到指定的组织单元OU中
parameters.name: domain_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the AD user that has the permission to join computers to the domain
parameters.help_zh: 具有加域权限的AD用户的密码
parameters.name: domain_password
